note: Effect profiles for the native WoW spell effects of the match animations. Edit this file, then run python tools/fx/gen_effect_profiles.py to regenerate addon/Hearthstone/MatchFxProfiles.lua. Model paths point into the player's installed WoW data; nothing is redistributed. Every preset starts verified=false: check it in game with /hs fx and only then flip it. source: design = present in the owner's client, client = found in the client data (SpellVisualEffectName.dbc). exists = the file is in the client MPQs (tools/fx/mpq_has.py), verified = it looked right in game. scale = relative size (1 = the on-screen size MatchFx.lua derives from the anchor and the calibration), pos = a small offset in model units on top of the centred placement, ext = natural radius of the model in yards (tools/fx/model_extents.py), size = optional on-screen diameter in design pixels that overrides the derived size. Variant/dependency records and mixed-mode/ambiguous cards stay legacy. Result collisions use first event order.
